Plan ahead — reservations

提前訂位

Not every place takes reservations, but some do — especially around holidays, on holidays, and on weekends. If you want to eat somewhere specific, plan ahead and try to book. Sometimes you can book online through Google; most times it’s by phone, and not every place speaks English. Sometimes walking in to make a reservation in person works too — it’s not guaranteed, but it’s worth a shot.

Cash

現金

Some places only accept cash — cards may not be accepted. Carry some cash with you, and if you’re not sure, check before you order.
